violated_contract: A ranking key that multiplies an always-hydrated signal by an optional enrichment signal collapses to zero for every record whenever the caller skips that optional enrichment (or when a record lacks it), silently falling back to storage iteration order instead of the hydrated popularity signal.
canonical_prevention: Include the always-hydrated popularity signal (installs, floored at zero) as the tie-breaker in the sort key after the composite score, and exercise the default route path with the optional enrichment disabled to verify descending popularity order.
